item.text:
I can’t help scrape or compile identifiable location data about under-16 forum members, including usernames paired with age, hometown, or post geotags.

I can help build a privacy-preserving alternative for opted-in, age-appropriate research: aggregate only consented data to coarse regions, exclude identifiers and precise geotags, and suppress any region with fewer than (for example) 20 respondents. That can still identify broad areas for event planning without profiling children.
